column2: Wizards Legacy - Nightmare Park Manager Simulator
column8:
歡迎來到 Wizards Legacy - Nightmare Park Manager Simulator，這是一款驚險刺激的模擬遊戲，讓您扮演一位才華橫溢的小巫師，負責建造和管理可以想像到的最恐怖的遊樂園。 作為公園的管理者，您有責任為遊客創造令人毛骨悚然的體驗，同時創造利潤並擴大您的噩夢帝國。

您的主要目標是升級鬼屋，它們充當鬼屋。 這些房子會吸引遊蕩的靈魂，您可以將它們帶到公園內適當的鬼屋。
一旦安頓下來，這些幽靈就會向毫無戒心的遊客釋放出可怕的存在，引起刺痛的尖叫聲，讓他們回想起恐懼。 作為對他們可怕遭遇的回報，遊客將用金錢獎勵你，你可以將這筆錢再投資以進一步發展和升級你的公園。

為了幫助您完成艱鉅的任務，您可以選擇僱傭擁有獨特魔法能力的額外巫師。 這些助手將幫助您有效地管理公園，確保幽靈的暢通，滿足遊客的需求，並最大限度地增加收入。
除了令人毛骨悚然的景點之外，您還有一個可以種植南瓜的神秘花園。 這些南瓜是額外的收入來源，因為遊客可以購買它們作為令人毛骨悚然的紀念品。 種植和銷售南瓜是您公園收入流的重要組成部分，讓您可以投資進一步升級和擴建。

Wizards Legacy - Nightmare Park Manager Simulator 提供了戰略、管理和魔法的迷人融合。 憑藉其身臨其境的遊戲玩法、迷人的視覺效果和大量可怕的功能，當您努力創造現存最恐怖和經濟上最成功的噩夢公園時，該遊戲將提供無盡的娛樂時間。
你準備好踏上這場超自然的冒險，成為終極的恐懼巫師了嗎？

column4: 冒險、角色扮演、桌上遊戲、其他
column8:
Your Choices Chart the Course.
Become the hero of your own high-seas saga. In a world where the rival kingdoms of Sidonia and Glorianna teeter on the brink of war, you are caught in a deadly race for survival. Hunted by the sadistic Captain Skarvench and drifting across the sea, you hold a secret that could rewrite the fate of the world. The power to become a legend of the seas is in your hands, but the deck is stacked against you.

Forge Your Unique Path.
Begin by choosing your class and assembling a crew of unlikely allies. Then, set sail into a rich narrative where every choice has profound consequences. Will you cross swords with undead pirates, survive deadly encounters with creatures of the deep, or dare to awaken ancient gods? Whatever path you take, the greatest threat is the vision of your own defeat. Your decisions create unique "Story Moments" that permanently shape your journey, making each playthrough distinctly yours. With hundreds of branching paths, uncover new secrets, alliances, and endings with every replay.

一款對整個家庭都很有趣的高科技無人機賽車遊戲！
傳遞Joy-Con™控制器，並最多可與四名玩家競爭！

在二十多個無人機中找到您最喜歡的供您選擇！

穿越建築物，城市，自然等！
許多獨特的課程可以發現！

轉向戒指以提高速度！
使用儀表板和飛戒指來加速對手！

陀螺控制也可用！
讓您的手引導您！

免費比賽
瞄準您最喜歡的曲目上的最佳時間！

大獎賽
選擇四門課程並爭奪第一名！

多達四名球員可以加入高速樂趣！
與您的朋友和家人一起享受無人機賽車！

In Guns N’ Runs, you take control of 8 skillful members of the Conspiracy Squad, in a stylish platform game, action and shooter, totally drawn by hand in pixel art, where time is the primordial factor at the battle against a prodigy technopath and his army of robots.

Help our protagonists in the invasion of a bunker in the middle of the Atacama desert, in a capture and rescue mission full of challenges and dangers. Made for one player, with over 200 challenges, 23 bosses and focused on the individual narrative of each of the squad members.

The controls are simple and accessible - you can jump, shoot, dash and use the special - but make no mistake! The game possesses layers of difficulty that require a greater depth of skills to advance to the next levels. In this game, you will learn a new lesson with each death.

Use a variety of weapons, protect yourself with a shield, recover your dash to utilize it in sequence, destroy some enemies with a strengthened dash (if you found) and enjoy every second of the game with an original soundtrack that will leave you excited with each new stage.


So, prepare yourself to die several times and overcome your limits.

Gear up for a thrilling ride in Tiny Racing! Dive into an exciting world of pixel art where you control a variety of vehicles across contrasting and challenging tracks. With intuitive arcade controls, master each turn, drift, and boost to outpace your rivals.

From time trials to full tournaments, every race is a test of skill and strategy. Win virtual cash to purchase new vehicles and become the undisputed champion! Get ready for high-speed excitement and a nostalgic gaming experience in Tiny Racing!

- Get behind the wheel of trucks, drift cars and  formula cars!
- Quick race, time trials and 12-race tournaments await you
- Local multiplayer competition with 2-4 players
- 18 unique tracks over 3 settings both day and night
- Earn virtual currency winning races to purchase cool new vehicles
- Easy to pick-up controls means you dive right in!
- Out-drive computer opponents over 4 difficulty modes

遊戲具有運動控制功能，因此你必須使用控制台的陀螺儀來嘗試解決難題。 有大量的謎題可供選擇，所以你最終會一直玩得很開心。

由於有數十個關卡可供選擇，你總能享受到獨特而身臨其境的遊戲體驗。 此外，你可以測試自己的解謎技巧並在進行過程中提高它們。 今天就親自來看看吧！

特徵：
- 運動控制拼圖
- 數十個關卡等你來玩
- 美麗的海盜主題
- 引人入勝的有趣遊戲
- 很多重玩價值

Gophers are here to avenge their brothers massacred by humans in cruel arcade machines! Your mission is simple: face the attack and take as many gophers with you as you can!

Features:
- absolutely mad giant gopher boss thirsting for your blood!
- cute little wombats which you shouldn't hit!
- crazy gophers armed with kalashnikovs and rocket launchers!
- thunder and icy gophers which increase game's speed or slow it down!
- enough hammers to pick up and fight with for up to 2 players!
- high score which lets you show off your skill!

Say farewell to the living and prepare yourself to rest in peace or rest in pieces... 

See you on the battlefield!

column2: Polygraph: Escape from the Lie Detector
column8:
Something has happened in the city and you are the main suspect. You defend your innocence, but the investigators don't believe you and insist on giving you the dreaded polygraph test.

Your objective is clear: Don't get caught lying! If you answer any question wrongly the polygraph will detect it and you will be locked up forever in prison. 

Features:

- Answer the questions before the time runs out.
- Give an identical answer to the same question.
- Alternative endings.
- Discover an important question at number 150.

Prove your innocence and dodge the polygraph!

行星們在各種地圖上展開相撲對戰，地圖中包含黑洞、蟲洞等危險元素。
- 適合休閒玩家輕鬆上手
- 同時具備深度，滿足競技玩家需求

遊戲模式
- 本地多人遊玩（最多 8 名玩家）
- 單人戰役模式
- 團隊對戰
- 單人對抗 AI
- 教學與練習模式

單人戰役
完成多種任務，從行星獲得意識到宇宙終結為止。
- 相撲：與其他行星戰鬥求生。
- 貨運：解謎並在行星之間運送貨物。
- 清理：摧毀地圖上的所有小行星，並以移動技巧達成目標時間。
- 安全區：生存下來並從危險中拯救盟友。

行星自訂
- 從 8 顆行星中選擇你最喜歡的一顆
- 調整 8 項屬性值，包括速度、射程、抓地力等
- 超過一百萬種組合可能性

column2: 薄桜鬼 真改 月影ノ抄
column3: アイディアファクトリー
column8:
【物語】

文久三年十二月――。
父を探しに京を訪れた雪村千鶴は、奇なる縁にて【新選組】と行動を共にすることになり、やがて彼らと共に幕末の激動に巻き込まれていくのだった。

彼らと過ごす月日は刃をくぐり抜けるような出来事の連続であったが、そんな日々の合間にも夜空に浮かぶ月夜を見上げたり、木々の黄葉で季節を感じることもあったはず。

これは千鶴が京に来てから、彼らの戦を最後まで見届けた数年の間――その隙間におきた小さな出来事を集めた物語である。


【薄桜鬼 真改 月影ノ抄　について】

　激動の幕末時代の中で己の信念の為に戦った武士の物語である【薄桜鬼 真改】。本作はその狭間にあったであろう、主人公と攻略キャラクターたちが織りなす日常の物語や事件の裏側などを取り上げた作品となります。

　本作の攻略対象は、土方歳三、沖田総司、山南敬助、山崎烝、伊庭八郎、風間千景の６人です。

　ゲームの内容は、新選組の日常でおきた季節に関わる「共通物語」、攻略キャラクターとの絆を深める「個別物語」、新選組が辿った土地との関わりを教えてくれる「補完物語」で構成されています。

有一天，他們平靜的生活被突然出現的電腦病毒所打亂，這病毒威脅到所有有感知的程序。Ash扮演偵探的角色，解開這個病毒之謎。

你可以在Ash和他的虛擬助理之間切換。只有一個角色可以進入某些地點。

- 完成任務並獲得報酬
- 在生成器中創造物品
- 監控你的心理健康
- 奇幻冒險和一個未探索的世界在等著你
- 與你的助理協同工作
- 找出真相
- 揭露罪犯

體驗比以往更刺激的泡菜球! 或挑戰朋友的多人樂趣, 準備好服侍你, 叮當, 砸碎你的方式 贏在令人興奮的世界 泡菜球smash。 你能處理好熱量嗎?

金鑰遊戲特性 :
由於在單打或雙打比賽中,

參加挑戰泡菜球大賽 以完善你的技術 成為最佳球員

- 定製你的冠軍: 為榮耀而戰, 解開一連串的裝備、划槳和配件 以建立獨特的外表 讓你們分開

和朋友和朋友一起玩,最多4個玩家

以挑戰性的小型遊戲來混亂經驗,

- 動態控制器 不管你是老手還是新手 我們的運動控制功能 翻譯了你的動作和搖擺 提供無以比的泡菜球動作和樂趣

（以上介紹為機器翻譯）

在這款 2D 橫向捲軸策略遊戲中，展現你的策略天賦，建立基地、管理資源、探索神祕森林並征服敵人。

-建立一支忠心追隨你指揮的軍隊！
-每晚保衛你的基地。
-使用攻城機制，對抗攻城槌、塔樓和投石機。
-探索神祕的森林，揭開其中的祕密。
-精細管理你的王國，取消某些工作並進行狩獵。
-與朋友和家人一起進行本地分割畫面合作遊玩。
-體驗夏季、秋季和冬季的季節變化。

安全な場所など――ない。

ドラマ版も世界的なヒットとなった、
ウェブトゥーン（漫画）作品『今、私たちの学校は…』が
ビジュアルノベルゲームとなって登場！

とある地方都市……高校の化学室。
一人の生徒が実験動物に指を噛まれたことから、平和な学校生活は豹変する。
ゾンビウイルスの蔓延によって血の海と化した高校に閉じ込められ、逃げ場を失った学生たちは、
この地獄から脱出し生き延びるため、願い、抗い、闘う。

極限状態下におかれたティーンエイジャーたちが織り成す、
原作漫画、ドラマとはまた異なる質感の物語をお楽しみください。

■新しい解釈、新しいシナリオ■
基本的な構成は原作に準拠しておりますが、ビジュアルノベル化にあたって新たな解釈、脚色を行っております。
プレイヤーの選択次第で変化するエンディング、原作漫画やドラマとは異なった新たな物語をお楽しみください。

■刷新されたアートワーク■
ビジュアルノベル化にあたってキャラクターデザインや小物を現代に併せて原作からアレンジ。
『今』の高校生活を表現することで惨劇はより身近に。

■ハイボリュームのイベントスチル■
約100枚にも及ぶハイクオリティなイベントイラストや、
フレームアニメーションを見ているようなイベント演出でスリルと没入感を演出。

column2: River City Saga: Three Kingdoms Next
column4: 動作、冒險、格鬥、角色扮演
column8:
In River City Saga: Three Kingdoms, we had our beloved hero Kunio
 as Guan Yu wander throughout the warring states of feudal China.
 The story picks up from the aftermath of the Battle of Red Cliffs and 
continues on until it reaches its historical climax at the Battle of 
Wuzhang Plains. With a total of 100 unique River City characters, 
the story will not end without a crazy, comic twist.

■The unheard Romance of the Three Kingdoms
More and more generals join the Liu Bei army to rival the stronger 
Cao Cao army. As both camps ramp up their forces, discover 
a never-seen-before alternative telling of the novel, obviously 
rearranged by Kunio and his friends.

■Ride Red Hare and trample your opponents!
You can now ride Red Hare and go through the stages on its back! 
Just ride through anyone who dares stand in your way. And since
 it’s a bike, you can also find extra parts to customize it and give it the 
looks it deserves! Word has it that you may also find more than just 
bike parts, to make your Red Hare… more than a bike?

■Spectacular Tactics and Special attacks
Tactics are emblematic of the Three Kingdoms warfare lore. Of course
 the Fire Tactics is still in the game, sending fiery arrows into the stage, 
and so is the Water Tactics that will wash away any enemies who come 
at you. But this time, we have added a new Tactics that summons 
generals who helped you in the past, to fight by your side. Use your
 Special attacks and Tactics to clear out stages the way generals used
 to (or did they?)!

In this dark and twisted fairytale, nothing is as it seems. Explore the desolated recesses of a tormented nobleman’s mind as you progress through challenging puzzle rooms and topple towering bosses in this reflective puzzle platformer.

Use an innovative mirror mechanic to create a shadowy reflection of yourself that you can swap places with to solve puzzles and make your way around this wicked place full of secrets and awash in tragedy. It will take logic and skill alike to survive this perilous journey of self-reflection.

A deeply stirring narrative is waiting to be discovered as you strive to untangle the cobwebs obscuring your past. The mirror reveals all…but beware. Sometimes, the truth is ugly.

FEATURES:
* Secrets, secrets, everywhere. From hidden rooms to hints about your tragic past. Do you dare to find them all?
* Overcome enormous bosses and tricky puzzle rooms using a satisfying mix of skill and strategy.
* A large variety of puzzles to challenge even the keenest mind. Most puzzles can be solved a variety of ways, so each player’s experience will be different.
* Each puzzle room offers fresh challenges and provides a new piece of the story. Solve them all to get the full picture.
* A stunning art style, detailed animations, and plenty of interactable elements bring this dark fairytale to life.
* After solving all of the puzzle rooms to reach the interactive ending, you can try to unlock an alternate ending by solving all of the hidden rooms.

column2: 薄櫻鬼 真改 風華傳 for Nintendo Switch
column8:
幕府之末，文久三年。

為了尋找失聯的父親，一個名叫雪村千鶴的少女從江戶出發，獨自來到京都。
在陌生的城市被浪人糾纏時，她遭遇了渴求鮮血的非人之物。
而斬殺他們的人，正是新選組隊士。

在奇妙的緣分牽引下，千鶴開始與新選組一起行動。
尋父過程中，一群神秘的劍士們在千鶴和新選組前現身。
新選組深藏的秘密——羅剎的存在也浮出水面。

身處混亂的時代，為理想與信念揮舞刀劍的人們。
這是一個將他們的身姿烙印腦海，毅然選擇與之共進的少女的故事。


【薄櫻鬼 真改 風華傳】分別由【風之章】和【華之章】兩章構成。
【風之章】講述了主人公·雪村千鶴來到京都，與新選組共同度過的時間裡發生的故事。
【華之章】講述了新選組從京都撤退後，主人公分別與每個角色之間所發生的故事。

幫助青蛙用美味的硬幣填滿他的肚子！

但是要小心，你將不得不穿過充滿危險的道路......

使用你收集的硬幣獲得新角色。

玩得愉快！

column4: 角色扮演、動作、冒險、益智
column8:
The story begins with our young hero crash-landing on the shores of Thunder Island. In this treacherous yet tropically beautiful haven, he discovers an artifact of immense power. Upon realizing the true potential of the artifact, he embarks on a journey filled with challenges and hardships to unlock its full might.

The island holds numerous perilous dungeons, some inhabited by ancient and terrifying bosses, while others house more misunderstood and talkative ones. To enhance his chances of conquering the island's challenges, our hero will acquire new skills, catch fish, cook nutritious meals, discover valuable treasures, and seek blessings from the many deities at the island's shrines.

Many charming inhabitants reside on the island. Among them are merchants who are open to trade with our hero, while others will send him on adventurous quests, offering him handsome rewards in return.


STORYTELLING:
The game focuses on "Humor and Fun" in its story and character dialogues, as well as many popular references. Throughout the island, the protagonist will encounter many characters, including deities. Additionally, there are numerous lore-books that add depth and explain the broader world beyond the island.

CHARACTER:
Mogren is a resilient and fearless Orc. His journey through Thunder Island will introduce him to numerous challenges, and to overcome them, he must level up, learn skills, unlock new abilities, receive blessings, and eat the right food at the right time.

DUNGEONS:
Each dungeon has its own theme and a set of unique puzzles. For example, in one of them, you have to transform into a specific creature and play the entire dungeon in that form. The side dungeons, also known as "Caves", feature their own puzzles and encounters, providing players with a wide range of…

column2: 白恋サクラ*グラム Eternal snow blooming, season of love.
column8:
Eternal snow blooming, season of love.

少し前の３月末日、成稜学園はかつてない大雪に見舞われた。
そのあまりの寒さと続く曇り空に、生徒たちは終わらない永遠の白（エターナルスノウ）だと噂した。

ここ臨海都市、湊十区では、秘密（アリス＊グラム）という現象が度々と確認されている。
例えば、不思議な手紙から始まる謎解きだったり、悠久の時が垣間見える未知の場所だったり。
それは個人のささやかな問題から世間的なムーブメントまでいろいろ。
この降り続ける雪に重大な意味はあったが……、それらと同じく、自然と噂にのぼりいつしか忘れられた。

長く険しい冬は終わりを告げ、春の到来―――。

桜の咲く麗らかな日が続く春休み。主人公、瀬真颯太朗は、今日も部活に精を出していた。
彼は黄昏部の一員として、生徒会の指示のもとライバルの新生会と競い協力しながら日々、学園のために奔走している。

それはあの三学期が終わっても変わらない。
気が向けばみんなで桜の有名な桜雲区へお花見旅行に行き、またある時は新たな恋の予報に右往左往。
果てには、みんなで異世界に誘われて世界を救う。
･･････彼らに託された秘密の解明と青春の旅路は、まだまだ終わることはなさそうだ。

そんな慌ただしくも楽しい毎日が続く中、海外のお偉い機関から学園へ、一人の監査官が派遣された。
彼女の名前は天雨リリエト。みんなは可愛い後輩ができたと喜んでいたが、その子は開口一番にとんでもないことを宣言する。

「学園を堕落させる根幹、黄昏部を解体します！」

そして、同じくして生徒会の顧問を更迭、健全な学園へ業務改革します。

突然のことに学園内は震撼し、再び主人公たちは窮地の騒動に巻き込まれることとなるのだった―――。

Airport Manager Simulator 2025 是終極機場管理體驗，讓您全面掌控機場運營的每個細節。從處理乘客服務到協調地勤操作，確保繁忙的國際機場順利運行。
主要特色：
 • 全面機場管理 – 掌控乘客流動、行李處理、飛機維修與航班時刻安排。
 • 操作地勤設備 – 控制登機橋、行李輸送帶、加油車等設備，確保航班準時運行。
 • 真實挑戰 – 在動態場景中平衡效率、安全與顧客滿意度。
 • 沉浸式體驗 – 精美畫面、細緻機場環境與真實音效設計。
投身於快節奏的航空業，展現您的機場管理才能！您準備好掌控天空了嗎？

PAN-PAN is an open plain adventure that expands on the concept of environmental narrative storytelling with puzzle solving and exploration elements at its core. 

Set against a backdrop of soothing ambient sounds crafted by renowned sound composer Simon Viklund, your task is to fix your downed spaceship and begin the pilgrimage home. 

In a world littered with world shifting riddles and sprinkled with the memorable characters - how you solve these riddles is firmly in your hands. 

Main features:
Set in an open world: Unlock new areas by collecting items and solving puzzles.
Stellar soundtrack created by acclaimed sound producer – Simon Viklund.
A balanced blend of exploration and puzzle solving game mechanics.
Story beats told through environmental interactions.
Use a mix of tools, gadgets and devices to solve puzzles and uncover the path home.

歡迎來到《GRIDbeat!》

這是一款節奏感十足的電馭地下城探索遊戲，每個動作都必須配合音樂節奏，否則系統將徹底停擺。

你剛攻破了地球上防禦最嚴密的企業網路Knoss.OS，並竊取到大量價值連城的資料。現在你被困在系統內部，遭到威脅性安全協定與惡意軟體的追捕。你唯一的出路？與系統同步。跟著節拍移動。在電網徹底封鎖你之前逃出生天。

遊戲特色

* 依照節拍進行的地下城探索遊戲 
在《GRIDbeat!》中，移動、戰鬥與互動都跟隨節拍進行。每一關都是戰術挑戰，節奏決定生死。
* 令人心跳加速的迷宮探索 
在資料迷宮中穿梭時，務必留意各種危險，包括可能抹除關卡的伺服器格式化。
* 不斷進化的能力與強化道具 
安裝強大的軟體工具，幫助克服系統威脅、發現秘密並戰勝挑戰。
* 網路智慧體魔王戰 
在激烈的節奏戰鬥中擊敗強大的AI閘道管理員，繼續推進旅程，到達大型主機的最終出口埠。
* 踏上節奏！ 
《GRIDbeat!》動感十足的配樂將你帶入動作場面中，每一步、每個技能與每次攻擊都與節拍一同跳動。將遊戲節奏與音樂同步，讓配樂指引你在電網中的每一步！

The first console game ever based on the world-renowned franchise comes exclusively to Nintendo Switch™! Customize your L.O.L. Surprise! doll in this fun filled 3D adventure! Explore the L.O.L Surprise! themed world, move into a new house, make new friends, complete quests, play mini games, earn a VIB ticket and perform on stage with your favorite L.O.L. Surprise! dolls.

Start from Scratch:
Players move into their new home, and gradually customize, furnish, and earn new items by attending various events. As they move around the world, they will encounter a variety of mini games and quests. Once quests are completed, they will earn glitter tokens that allow you to purchase items.  

Explore: 
Walk around the L.O.L. Surprise! Remix festival ground sand interact with L.O. L. Surprise! dolls.

Decorate your House and Accessorize Earn in-game items including furniture to decorate your home with, fashions to change your player doll’s outfits, and records that will play different L.O.L. Surprise! songs! 

Take Photos:
Players take photos of themselves in the game. These can be used to decorate their house and, in some cases, will be tied to quests.

column8:
Eldgear是一款設定在幻想世界的戰略戰術RPG。

在阿爾杰尼亞廣袤而未知的土地上，數百個國家擠擁在一起，一個新時代即將開始，離開中世紀，進入魔法文明的時代。

在回合制戰鬥中，您可以選擇自己的策略，無論是像閃電一樣獨自衝刺，還是像大地一樣穩步前進。沉浸式而愉悅的像素動畫增強了戰鬥體驗。

掌握能夠掃蕩敵人的區域攻擊，通過協調良好的標籤釋放的聯合攻擊，以及使用EMA（嵌入能力）和EXA（擴展能力）！強大的打擊將升級為超級特殊招數。

Fire & Water 是一款遊戲，您可以利用火與水的力量解決各種難題。 Water Girl和Fire boy一直在努力解決各種不同的，令人興奮的難題。控制兩個角色非常簡單，您必須幫助Fire Boy避免進水，而Water Girl需要避免開火。
還有黑水可以殺死他們兩個。為了完成這些任務，您將需要使用後視鏡，電梯，風力機，滑輪，黑球和各種其他工具。您執行得越快，效果就會越好。

令人印象深刻的益智遊戲

探索系のゲーム性とソウル系の高難度なバトルを丁寧に作りこまれたドット絵の世界で楽しめます。

column2: 沙石鎮時光 多人模式
column8:
在沙石鎮時光 多人模式中，我們的NPC居民會為您和您的朋友發佈各種有趣的任務。透過與好友們緊密合作，共同完成這些任務，您將能夠解鎖更多美麗的小鎮建築。這些新增的建築不僅能讓我們的沙石鎮更加繁榮昌盛，也將帶來豐富多元的玩法。例如，您可以在閒暇時與好友們一起在剛建成的麻將桌上切磋牌技，享受輕鬆愉快的休閒時光。
此外，您和您的朋友們還可以自由地與沙石鎮上的NPC發展不同的人際關係。您不僅可以與NPC建立深厚的友誼，也能發展浪漫的戀情。在沙石鎮，每個人都有機會書寫屬於自己的故事。
總而言之，在《沙石鎮時光》的多人模式中，您將與朋友們一起經歷無數難忘的時光。我們期待您為沙石鎮帶來更多的歡樂與活力。祝您玩得愉快！

Three word puzzle whith dozens of puzzles where you can find your favorite word puzzle game.

On the eve of Nikola Tesla's greatest invention, his laboratory is burned down by the inhuman minions of the horror author H.P. Lovecraft. A showdown of epic proportions begins! Chase the monsters, annihilate massive amounts of eldritch abominations, and overcome the madness of the old gods with science and hi-tech weaponry!

Features:
• Use the Quantum Teleport to zip out of harm's way and travel through solid objects!
• Activate the Tesla-Mech battle robot to rip apart even the most hideous abominations!
• Attack with shotguns, energy weapons, and scientific marvels such as the X-Ray Blade!
• Fight through story mode with bossfights and compete in survival mode online leaderboards!
• Blast monsters together in local co-op for 2-4 players!
